content.body: The Blen-T is a "test hack stand in" for the Beaufort Torpedo Bomber. The pilot can launch the torpedo using the secondary fire key. The torpedo should not be launched above 200 feet or 150 mph.
content.brief: TYPE: Torpedo Bomber CREW: 2 WEIGHT: 6810 kg MAX SPEED: 418 kph ARMAMENT: 2 X 7.7mm LMG 1 x 1522 kg torpedo
content.title: Blenheim Torpedo Bomber
